scstamp-seq.title: scSTAMP-seq (2025 preprint implementation)
scstamp-seq.scope: Describe the general source-defined assay from the stated starting specimen through the molecular readout and its decoding. Preserve source-described alternative assay implementations and their prerequisites without merging them into one execution. Include necessary preparation, controls, information attribution and delegated procedural dependencies; distinguish method construction from characterization experiments and biological applications.
scstamp-seq.variant: bioRxiv version 1, posted 2025-10-02; DOI 10.1101/2025.10.01.679703. The later Nature Biotechnology publication is a distinct version and is not an extraction source for this attempt.
